name: Titanium.UI.ActivityIndicatorStyle
summary: A set of constants for the styles available for [Titanium.UI.ActivityIndicator](api:Titanium.UI.ActivityIndicator) objects.

properties.name: BIG
properties.description:
Used with the [Titanium.UI.ActivityIndicator.style](api:Titanium.UI.ActivityIndicator#style) property.

One of the group of activity indicator style constants
[DARK](api:Titanium.UI.ActivityIndicatorStyle#DARK),
[BIG](api:Titanium.UI.ActivityIndicatorStyle#BIG),
[BIG_DARK](api:Titanium.UI.ActivityIndicatorStyle#BIG_DARK),
and [PLAIN](api:Titanium.UI.ActivityIndicatorStyle#PLAIN).

properties.name: BIG_DARK
properties.description:
Used with the [Titanium.UI.ActivityIndicator.style](api:Titanium.UI.ActivityIndicator#style) property.

Note: Although this constant is not available on iOS, you accomplish
this behavior by setting the style to `Ti.UI.ActivityIndicatorStyle.BIG`
and use the [Titanium.UI.ActivityIndicator.indicatorColor](api:Titanium.UI.ActivityIndicator#indicatorColor) property to
tint the indicator.

One of the group of activity indicator style constants
[DARK](api:Titanium.UI.ActivityIndicatorStyle#DARK),
[BIG](api:Titanium.UI.ActivityIndicatorStyle#BIG),
[BIG_DARK](api:Titanium.UI.ActivityIndicatorStyle#BIG_DARK),
and [PLAIN](api:Titanium.UI.ActivityIndicatorStyle#PLAIN).
